content_sections.heading: MAHE Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the project titled "Deciphering if Parkinson’s disease is a proteinopathy or lipidopathy due to mTOR deregulation, in genetic models of PD" at the Center for Molecular Neurosciences, Kasturba Medical College (KMC), Manipal.

content_sections.heading: MAHE Junior Research Fellow Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc/M.Pharm/M.Tech candidates who have qualified for the Category I or Category II merit list of DBT-BET exam or NET/GATE qualified candidates. Candidates with a background in Biology/Pharmacology will be preferred, but not mandatory. Willingness to work with mice and transgenic mice is required for this project.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this JRF post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), Manipal, for Kasturba Medical College (KMC), Manipal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MAHE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MAHE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required for the MAHE Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc/M.Pharm/M.Tech degree and have qualified for the Category I or Category II merit list of DBT-BET exam or be NET/GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for MAHE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the MAHE Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply with a detailed CV and copies of certificates via email to [email protected], mentioning the Job Code in the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MAHE Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on qualifications and will be informed by e-mail about the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of engagement for this Junior Research Fellow project?
faq.answer: The duration of engagement is initially for a period of one year and is extendable up to three years based on performance and need of the project.
